title: Bell Springs Winery & Brewery
specs: Dog friendly with dogs allowed inside tasting room and on patio
Both winery and brewery on same property with seasonal rotating wines and beers
Full kitchen serving elevated comfort food with local ingredients
Kid-friendly with playground and kid menu
Live music on Fridays and Saturdays during spring and fall
Membership open to adults age 21 and over
Someone 21 or older must be available to sign for shipments
Groups of 11+ require booking at least 24 hours in advance
Property can accommodate 200+ guests for private events

options.name: Membership Club
options.detail: Monthly subscription with minimum 3 months commitment

includes: Charcuterie board included with guided tasting
Member discounts on wine, beer, food, merchandise, and events
Free tastings or flights for two on day of joining membership
gap: Age minimum for guided tasting not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy a one-hour guided wine or beer tasting paired with a charcuterie board. The venue is dog friendly, with indoor and outdoor seating, a full kitchen serving food all day, and a playground for kids. Membership clubs offer flexible monthly credits or quarterly curated wine shipments with exclusive perks.
extraNote: Membership club requires minimum 3 months commitment and 14 days written notice to cancel · Wine club requires minimum one quarterly order; skipping shipments not permitted · Cancellation requests must be written and confirmed by Bell Springs · No refunds for uncollected wines or unprocessed shipments unless Bell Springs error · Groups must book at least 24 hours in advance; 24 hours notice required for cancellations · No shows billed at half price; no refund for prepaid group no shows · No outside alcohol allowed on property; intoxicated guests will be asked to leave · Tasting room at 3700 Bell Springs Rd, Dripping Springs, TX 78620
